top_choice_rationale: P001 (Katori and Ye, optical lattice clocks) rests on one identifiable mechanism, the magic wavelength that cancels the lattice light shift so many neutral atoms are interrogated Doppler- and recoil-free. The realisation reached about 1e-18 fractional uncertainty and has been reproduced independently by several laboratories and checked by cross-site comparisons, so the systematics are understood and the result will last. The citation should stay on the concept and its realisation, not on the pending redefinition of the second. I rank P002 (theta-13) second as the cleanest discovery about nature but with a thinner attribution (Double Chooz omitted) and a need to separate it from the 2015 prize. I rank P003 (topological insulators) third because attribution omits the HgTe proposal of Bernevig, Hughes and Zhang. P000 is last: the shortlist has mature, confirmed achievements.
recusal_note: Professional affinity from PAMELA, Fermi-LAT and XL-Calibur work with astroparticle/neutrino-adjacent topics (P002, B024); I would accept recusal there. No direct tie to Katori, Ye or the lattice-clock groups apparent from profile.
